[[File:Pokemon Heritage.png|thumb|Pokémon: Heritage Collection box]] [[File:Heritage Poke Ball.png|thumb|Pokémon: Heritage Collection Poké Ball mold]] '''Pokémon: Heritage Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on November 19, 2014. It contains 54 discs with 460 episodes across them combined. Its catalog number is BHE5566. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all episodes from [[season]]s [[S01|1]] to [[S09|9]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}, except ''[[Holiday Hi-Jynx]]'', ''[[EP090|Stage Fight!]]'', and ''[[EP099|The Mandarin Island Miss Match]]'' (which all featured Jynx in its original design). In Region 4 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to standard broadcast [[season]]s, rather than by [[VIZ Media]] DVD season. The discs are contained in a large hand-painted {{i|Poké Ball}} mold.
